jobs.title: Senior Vice President, Portfolio Strategy Consulting
jobs.description:
Make your next move an expert one.
At Colliers it’s not our success that sets us apart, it’s how we achieve it. Our people are passionate, take ownership and always do what’s right for our clients, people and communities.

Why Colliers?
Our enterprising environment needs your expertise to facilitate Colliers’ continued growth as an industry leader. Our nimble, decentralized culture can provide you with a wealth of opportunities to learn about our business and quickly gain experience to accelerate your career.

***This role is a Remote arrangement from one of the States listed.***

About you
As the SVP of Portfolio Strategy Consulting, Global Occupier Services, you will be a senior, client-facing leader responsible for developing, selling, and leading client engagements focused on delivering high-impact, analytics-driven real estate advisory solutions. This role optimizes client portfolios, aligns locations with business objectives, drives operational and financial value, and strengthens the firm's position as a trusted industry advisor.

You will partner closely with Global Occupier Services advisory teams to translate complex business and real estate challenges into actionable portfolio strategies, site selection guidance, business process improvements, and portfolio optimization recommendations.

You are a recognized industry leader, with a proven track record of leading multi-disciplinary teams and executing complex, multi-market client engagements that incorporate organizational, operational, market, and financial analysis to support high-stakes decision-making .

In this role, you will…
- Lead BD efforts with prospective and existing clients, partnering closely with GOS Leasers, account managers, clients & solutions leaders to originate and win / expand new business.
- Serve as a trusted advisor to occupier clients, leading strategic discussions on portfolio optimization, location strategy, and workplace transformation.
- Translate complex client challenges into clear, actionable, and financially defensible recommendations.
- Drive revenue growth by deepening client relationships, expanding service offerings, and supporting high-value pursuits.
- Lead multi-market portfolio assessments, including consolidation, expansion, and optimization studies across national and global portfolios.
- Serve as a recognized thought leader in commercial real estate portfolio optimization, location strategy, site selection, and planning.
- Provide oversight for metro-market strategy consulting, ensuring consistency, rigor, and alignment with client objectives across regions.
- Develop and implement innovative methodologies, frameworks, and analytical tools to differentiate the firm's portfolio strategy offerings.
- Advise clients on corporate real estate organizational design, including portfolio governance, team structure, and operational processes to maximize efficiency and strategic impact.
- Guide clients in aligning their real estate organization with broader business objectives and portfolio goals.
- Lead business analytics, KPI development, and performance measurement initiatives to inform strategic portfolio decisions.
- Develop best-in-class business cases, including scenario analysis, cost-benefit evaluation, financial modeling, and market analysis.
- Ensure all client recommendations are quantifiable, defensible, and tied to measurable outcomes.
- Conduct detailed financial, operational, and market assessments to support portfolio decisions, site selection, and strategic planning.
- Translate complex datasets into actionable insights for executive-level clients.
- Manage and mentor portfolio strategy consultants and/or analysts.
- Promote cross-functional collaboration with consulting, brokerage, and other practice teams to ensure integrated solutions.
- Foster a culture of excellence, accountability, and innovation within the portfolio strategy practice.
- Demonstrate resilience under pressure, handling job stress effectively while interacting professionally with clients and colleagues.
- Act with honesty, integrity, and composure in all interactions, both internally and externally

What you bring
- 10+ years of experience in corporate real estate, consulting, or portfolio strategy advisory.
- Bachelor's degree (BS/BA) in economics, finance, accounting, business, real estate, or related field required.
- Advanced degree (MBA or MS) preferred.
- Deep experience in portfolio strategy, site selection methodology, portfolio optimization, and organizational design preferred.
- Experience advising complex real estate portfolios, including multi-location, regional, or global occupier strategies.
- Experience in portfolio optimization, metro-market strategy, site selection, organizational design, and incentives strategy preferred.
- Demonstrated leadership in multi-disciplinary teams focused on multi-market or national-level real estate portfolios.
- Expertise in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) and business intelligence platforms (e.g., Power BI, Tableau); experience with IWMS and CAFM systems.
- Training or familiarity with process improvement methodologies, including Lean Thinking or Six Sigma, is a plus.
- Strong analytical and technical orientation with a focus on data-driven decision-making.
- Analytical thinker capable of big-picture analysis and calculated risk-taking.
- Effective communication style with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.
- Ability to lead, mentor, and inspire teams while aligning them with organizational and client objectives.

- Focus on achieving measurable client impact through portfolio optimization, financial modeling, and organizational strategy

jobs.description:
Accelerate your success at Colliers.

Why Colliers?
As one of Canada’s leading commercial real estate services firms, we are driven by our mission to accelerate success for our people, clients, and communities.

A career at Colliers gives you the opportunity to make an impact, advance your career, and collaborate with top-tier talent. Don’t just take our word for it – we’ve been recognized as a top employer on a number of prestigious lists, including Best Workplaces in Canada, Best Workplaces with Most Trusted Executive Teams, among others.

***This position is for an Operations Manager based at Cedarbrae Centre in Scarborough, Ontario***

About the Role
As Operations Manager within our REMS team, you'll play a pivotal role in overseeing the operations of Cedarbrae Centre a retail asset within our portfolio. You will oversee the daily operation and routine maintenance of the building's physical systems while ensuring tenant requests are addressed promptly and professionally.
You are driven by customer service and take pride in the quality of work and service delivered by your team. You work effectively with individuals at all levels, including clients, external vendors, and corporate teams (HR, IT, Leasing, etc.), and collaborate closely with the General Manager and other on-site management team members.
You have a strong track record of leading, managing, and successfully delivering large capital projects while implementing preventative maintenance programs for commercial assets. You consistently meet and exceed business objectives, ensuring the achievement of key performance indicators (KPIs) and operational financial targets. You are forward-thinking, innovative, and eager to leverage your expertise to help shape the future of our industry.

Responsibilities
- Manage, mentor, and provide guidance and training to the building operations team.

- Effectively multitask while recognizing and addressing important and time-sensitive priorities.

- Review operations and implement energy-efficiency initiatives while ensuring the building operates in accordance with sustainability programs.

- Understand expense controls and successfully operate within established budgets.

What You'll Bring
- Minimum of 5 to 10 years of progressive building operations experience and 5+ years of progressive leadership experience , including managing teams of building operators and fostering strong client and tenant relationships, preferably within retail assets.

- Proven experience preparing, writing, and presenting business cases for capital projects from budgeting through to completion.

- Demonstrated problem-solving skills when working with teams, clients, vendors, and tenants.

- Strong strategic thinking, with experience identifying and implementing innovative, cost-effective solutions.

- Knowledgeable about all aspects of emergency management and supporting emergency response teams.

- Experience writing and managing tenders for large-scale contracts (RFQs/RFPs) and preparing related client business cases.

- Proven and decisive decision-making abilities; experience working with other departments (Construction, Accounting, Leasing) is considered an asset.

- Experience working within critical systems environments.

- Experience managing and implementing ESG projects is preferred.

- SMA or FMA designation, BES, SMT, HVAC Technician certification, or a 4th/5th Class Power Engineer certification (or equivalent) is preferred.

- RPA designation, LEED AP, PMP, or an equivalent designation is considered an asset.

- Knowledge of Direct Digital Control (DDC) systems, including operation and troubleshooting.

- Ability to oversee tenant build-outs and property improvement projects.

- Experience preparing and managing property operations budgets.

- Knowledge of applicable building and fire codes.

- Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, etc.), smartphones, and other technology devices.

- Experience with Yardi Voyager, Yardi FM, Angus, or Building Engines work order systems.

- Valid driver's license.

jobs.title: Financial Analyst
jobs.location: Indianapolis, Indiana, United States of America
jobs.description:
Make your next move an expert one.
At Colliers it’s not our success that sets us apart, it’s how we achieve it. Our people are passionate, take ownership and always do what’s right for our clients, people and communities.

Why Colliers?
Our enterprising environment needs your expertise to facilitate Colliers’ continued growth as an industry leader. Our nimble, decentralized culture can provide you with a wealth of opportunities to learn about our business and quickly gain experience to accelerate your career.

**This position is an onsite role based out of our Indianapolis office**

About you
You are great with numbers AND people. As a trusted and reliable member of our team, you bring a positive, customer service approach that benefits our clients and everyone you work with.  You love diving deep into research and financial analysis to provide ultimate solutions and proposals to your clients. You’re passionate about commercial real estate and looking for an opportunity to expand your knowledge in the industry.

As a Financial Analyst you will be at the heart of our support operations by providing expert financial analysis and other analytical work to support transaction management the capital markets team based in Indianapolis, Indiana. Armed with exceptional analytical and organizational skills and a keen eye for detail, you’re a problem solver who’s always looking for ways to improve internal processes to achieve better results.

In this role, you will…
- Work closely with the Senior Analyst and senior advisors to support investment sales and equity-raising assignments across industrial, office, and retail properties throughout the Midwest.

- Underwrite acquisitions, dispositions, and ground-up development opportunities in ARGUS and Excel, including property-level cash flow projections, development pro formas, discounted cash flow analyses, valuation sensitivities, debt scenarios, and levered and unlevered returns.

- Support equity capital raises and joint venture assignments for ground-up developments, including analysis of development budgets, construction and lease-up assumptions, sources and uses, capital structures, and projected investor returns.

- Analyze rent rolls, leases, historical operating statements, budgets, expense recoveries, capital expenditures, and other property-level information to develop and support underwriting assumptions.

- Apply critical thinking and sound judgment to evaluate incomplete or conflicting information, identify the key issues affecting an assignment, and develop practical solutions without requiring a fully prescribed process.

- Identify missing information, inconsistencies, and potential areas of concern within property financials, leases, development assumptions, and due diligence materials, and determine the most efficient path to resolve them.

- Develop market-supported assumptions through analysis of comparable sales and leases, market fundamentals, tenant credit, replacement costs, development activity, and current capital markets conditions in conjunction with local leasing teams.

- Look beyond model outputs to identify investment strengths, risks, value-creation opportunities, trends, outliers, and logical inconsistencies that may influence valuation, deal structure, and transaction positioning.

- Translate complex financial and property-level information into clear, concise conclusions that senior advisors, clients, and investors can use to make decisions.

- Participate in client meetings, valuation presentations, investor calls, and internal strategy discussions, including presenting and defending underwriting assumptions and financial conclusions.

- Coordinate with clients, property managers, leasing teams, lenders, attorneys, and third-party consultants to collect and validate information throughout underwriting, marketing, and due diligence.

- Manage multiple active assignments and shifting priorities, independently determining how to organize and complete work accurately within transaction-driven deadlines.

- Leverage AI, automation, and other technology to improve research, analysis, reporting, document preparation, and recurring team workflows while exercising appropriate judgment, quality control, and confidentiality.

- Approach assignments and existing processes with curiosity, proactively identify inefficiencies, and recommend practical improvements that increase the team’s accuracy, consistency, and speed.

jobs.description:

Il s’agit d’un poste en présentiel basé au bureau de Montréal (Québec).

À propos du poste
L’Analyste financier sera responsable de soutenir une équipe de vente d’investissements parmi les plus performantes et actives du marché à Montréal, Québec. Évoluant dans un environnement dynamique et axé sur les transactions, vous assumerez l’entière responsabilité des processus d’évaluation financière. Cela comprend la préparation des analyses financières lors des présentations à des clients potentiels ainsi que la gestion du processus de vérification diligente financière auprès d’acquéreurs potentiels.
Ce poste s’inscrit dans un environnement collaboratif réunissant les équipes de courtage, de marketing et des opérations.

Dans ce rôle, vous devrez :
- Effectuer l’évaluation de terrains et de sites de développement partout au Québec afin de déterminer leur utilisation optimale, notamment au moyen d’analyses de valeur résiduelle du terrain et de modèles financiers de développement.

- Effectuer l’analyse financière d’immeubles commerciaux générateurs de revenus à l’aide de modèles Excel avancés, incluant les approches par taux d’actualisation directe (direct cap) et flux de trésorerie actualisés (DCF).

- Démontrer une solide compréhension des stratégies de création de valeur (value add), notamment la conversion de loyers sous le marché vers les loyers du marché, la location d’espaces vacants, les refinancements à long terme ainsi que l’atteinte des rendements ciblés (TRI, rendement sur coût)

- Concevoir, résumer et présenter des scénarios complexes de modélisation financière tout en expliquant l’incidence des différentes hypothèses retenues.

- Examiner, analyser, comprendre, synthétiser et interpréter divers documents immobiliers, notamment des baux, évaluations, budgets, relevés locatifs, rapports sur l’état des immeubles, études environnementales, plans architecturaux et règlements de zonage.

- Élaborer du contenu, préparer des présentations et rédiger des mémorandums d’information destinés aux investisseurs.

- Collaborer avec les équipes de financement afin d’effectuer les analyses selon différents scénarios de financement.

- Recueillir et suivre des données financières essentielles à des fins de recherche, d’analyse et de négociation.

- Analyser les documents hypothécaires et maîtriser les mécanismes de remboursement anticipé, de maintien du rendement et de substitution de garanties

- Présenter les résultats d’analyses financières dans un contexte professionnel auprès d’intervenants possédant différents niveaux de connaissances financières, notamment des courtiers internes et externes, gestionnaires immobiliers, prêteurs et propriétaires d’immeubles ou d’entreprises.

- Participer aux présentations commerciales, aux rencontres avec les prospects et les clients, et diriger les discussions portant sur la modélisation financière ainsi que sur les hypothèses utilisées.

- Assurer une veille constante des tendances du marché et de l’évolution du secteur immobilier.

Ce que vous apporterez
- Minimum de deux (2) années d’expérience en analyse financière, idéalement dans le secteur de l’immobilier commercial.

- Bilinguisme complet en français et en anglais, tant à l’oral qu’à l’écrit.

- Baccalauréat en finance, administration des affaires, commerce ou dans un domaine connexe.

- Excellentes capacités d’analyse et de recherche, avec un souci élevé de la qualité des données et de la précision.

- Expérience démontrée dans la conception de modèles financiers, les projections de flux de trésorerie, les calculs de TRI, les analyses DCF et les rendements Cash-on-Cash pour des actifs générateurs de revenus et des projets de développement.

- Maîtrise avancée de Microsoft Excel.

- Excellentes aptitudes en communication orale et écrite.

- Capacité à gérer plusieurs dossiers simultanément et à respecter des échéances serrées.

- Aptitudes démontrées à communiquer, collaborer et interagir efficacement avec divers intervenants.

- Capacité à évoluer dans un environnement multidisciplinaire complexe impliquant plusieurs départements, avec un minimum de supervision, tout en maintenant un haut niveau de performance sous pression.

_________

About the role
The Financial Analyst will be dedicated to supporting a high-volume and industry leading investment sale team in Montreal, QC.
